text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases and listening as broad ongoing interests, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose or experience driving the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend an established interest through a concrete connection, such as matching musical style or supporting an existing practical task.",
    "Complementary supplies and accessories appeal when they add a useful capability to equipment or materials users already own."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with more specific matches despite requiring unsupported projects, equipment ownership, or changes in taste.",
    "Repeated recommendations for similar products overlook whether users already have the capability, need another supply, or would choose only one alternative.",
    "Older or occasional interactions appear to outweigh recent choices and repeated patterns that better explain current intent."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product families, ecosystems, or broad entertainment genres appear to substitute for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "Interest in one activity appears to generalize into adjacent activities, such as extending mechanical fastening into electrical work or tablet ownership into home automation."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent interactions and repeated narrow interests provide stronger clues to current purpose, musical sound, or viewing mood than broad category membership.",
    "Practical choices depend on compatibility, quantity, existing supplies, and the additional capability an item provides.",
    "Unidentified items leave personal relevance uncertain; that uncertainty should not be interpreted as demonstrated content mismatch."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The leading recommendations contain too many broadly plausible associations whose specific usefulness or experiential fit is unsupported, leaving too few compelling next choices.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, distinguishing immediate choices from deferred interest and uncertain relevance.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to unsupported tasks, incompatible specifications, redundant capabilities, or excessive quantities.",
    "The share of top-ranked items with a concrete connection to recent or repeated interests, compared with items connected only through a broad category or ecosystem."
  ]
}
